author: Woah-its-Cam
body: Or, since I do solo play, should I swap classes entirely and focus on another route. I would take any suggestions

author: geoffnolan
body: If you go melee, choose the thief line. It’s much faster than the warrior line especially given this is your first character. But don’t forget to buy Druid somewhere down the line. The buffs are crucial.

author: No-Seaworthiness7013
body: Levelling Mage has been like pulling teeth with people constantly saying it gets better NEXT tier. I'd recommend going melee and wish someone had told me ages ago.

author: John__Nash
body:
People may complain but all the classes are playable. Pick the one that you like. 

If you are struggling then try upgrading some gear.

author: Boort93
body: You definitely want druid, but I recommend spellsword over mystic. Mystic felt like a downgrade

author: Both_Location_1474
body: Picking the right gear and upgrading that gear is almost more important than class especially the upgrading part. All the classes are quite usable if kitted out right, and upgraded for the love of it all.

author: Modangy
body:
Eventually you will unlock every class in the game. It's not usually a large issue to change things up if you want to try others out, as Orns are replaceable through effort. 

The main piece of advice I give players wanting to know what they "should" play, is simply "what you want". 

I've been playing Orna for 3 years come July, and throughout my various characters including my main initial character, I changed the classes and specs very regularly. It adds some fun factor itself just trying out the different gear an playstyles. 

Mage does get super fun around T8 in particular, with the T8, T9 and T10 classes all being super fun.

author: hmmm769
body:
Melee feels really slow for me but feels easier to get decent gear(?). Like more options.

Have had a blast with mage, going druid>nekro has had its slow moments but I slowed down at those times more to accumulate gear and then blast through the tiers.

author: madeyemorbo
body:
If you like being a caster, pick up one of the mage hybrids at t4. The warrior hybrid (spellsword) is a little better for leveling and the thief hybrid (mystic?) is good for PvP.

I'd pick one of those two just so you don't have to start from scratch on gear.
